meta.title: Iron Squid
meta.description: Win with every weapon. Lose once, start over. A public tracker for the Splatoon 3 gauntlet.

landing.stats: {runs, plural, =0 {No runs yet} one {# run} other {# runs}} · {completed} completed
landing.headline: Nobody has finished this.
landing.body: One random weapon, one random gear set, one life. Ten wins buys you another. Lose and you replay every weapon you've already cleared before you're allowed to meet a new one.
landing.conditionSkip: Skipping weapons or gear is not permitted; each must be used to achieve a victory.
landing.conditionShare: Progress is tracked here, and players are encouraged to share their runs.
landing.handleHint: Anyone can claim any name. Nothing here is verified, and nothing needs an account.
landing.createFailed: That did not go through. Try again.
landing.nobodyYet: Nobody has rolled yet. Be the first.

roll.title: The roll
roll.text: A weapon and a gear set are assigned at random. You don't choose them, and you can't re-roll.

lives.title: Lives
lives.text: You start a run with one life, and earn another for every ten victories within it.

win.title: The win
win.text: The weapon you were given stays yours until you win with it. There is no skipping, for any reason.

reset.title: The reset
reset.text: Lose your last life and the run is over. The next one starts from nothing — every weapon you had cleared goes back on the table.

end.title: The end
end.text: The challenge is complete when a single run has cleared every weapon in the game.

dashboard.head: Head
dashboard.iWonMobile: I won — roll the next one
dashboard.livesRemaining: {count, plural, one {# life} other {# lives}} remaining
dashboard.livesNote: {count, plural, one {# win} other {# wins}} from the next one.
dashboard.replayNote: If you drop this one, you replay all {count} cleared weapons before the armory opens again.
dashboard.honourSystem: Reporting is on the honour system. Your run page shows every entry, so lie at your own social cost.

armory.heading: The armory
armory.intro: Filled means cleared. Outlined means it is waiting for you. There is no third state, and no skipping.

log.heading: Run log
log.intro: Newest first. Deaths are the entries that cost you the armory.

publicRun.headline: {handle} is {cleared} weapons deep and has died {deaths, plural, one {once} other {# times}}.
